SpasiX — Setup & trading

SpasiX • BUILD 2026-10-24c • MetaTrader 5 (IC Markets) on Windows

Updating from the previous version (2 minutes)

  • Close the old app (SpasiXMT5.exe). From now on start SpasiX.exe (delete the old exe).
  • Copy the new SpasiXBridge.mq5 into MT5's MQL5\Experts folder (replace the old file) and restart MT5 — the bridge on your chart updates itself.
  • Your link setting (127.0.0.1) stays. Only if you want to TRADE from SpasiX: step 4 below.

1First time only: the bridge in MT5

  • MT5 → File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts → paste SpasiXBridge.mq5 → restart MT5.
  • MT5 → Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL → add http://127.0.0.1.
  • Drag SpasiXBridge onto ONE chart → OK. Start SpasiX.exe (first time: allow the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime; "Windows protected your PC" → More info → Run anyway).

2The chart

  • Symbols (cyan) at the top — ● = you have tickets on it • ＋ = add any instrument of your broker. Timeframes (gold) M1 … W1.
  • ▣ 1 / ◫ 2 / ⊞ 4 = split screen (click a chart to select it — the toolbar works on the selected one). 🕘 time zone (New York, London, Central Europe, … or MT5's server). 🎨 8 chart themes.
  • Indicators (each its colour): EMA 9 / 21 / 50 / 200, VWAP, FVG zones, NY opening range, yesterday's high / low.
  • Mouse: wheel = zoom • drag the chart = move • drag the time axis = stretch / squeeze the candles • drag the price axis = stretch the price • double-click or ⟲ NOW = back to now • right-click = the menu (timeframe, draw, indicators, theme, time zone, split, limit / stop orders at that price) • ⛶ FULL or F11 = the chart over the whole screen (Esc to leave).
  • Drawings: right-click ▸ Draw (horizontal / vertical line, trend line, rectangle) — click to select, drag to move, Del to delete. They are saved per symbol.
  • ⏱ next to the price = the time left in the candle. 📰 a banner warns before high-impact news of the chart's currencies (flashing 15 min before).

3Before trading: please test on a DEMO first

Trading from SpasiX sends REAL orders on a real account. Open a free IC Markets demo, log into it in MT5, attach the bridge there and try every button first. Nothing is sent unless BOTH switches below are on.

4Allow trading (only when you want it)

  • On the bridge's chart: right-click → Expert list → SpasiXBridge → Properties:
    Common → tick Allow Algo Trading • Inputs → AllowTrading = true (and MaxLotsPerOrder = your largest order) → OK.
  • Turn ON Algo Trading in the MT5 toolbar.
  • In SpasiX, the trade panel (right of the chart): 🔓 ARM TRADING → Yes. It stays armed until you DISARM or close SpasiX.

5Trading from SpasiX

  • LOTS (−/+ or 0.01 … 1.00), optional STOP / TARGET distance (gold: 5 = a $5 move) → SELL / BUY. It asks first unless you tick "one-click" (above 2 lots it always asks).
  • Limit / stop: pick the type, type the price or 🎯 PICK and click the chart → PLACE ORDER. Or right-click the chart at a price.
  • On the chart every ticket has its line and a label with ✕ (close it). Drag a ticket line up / down = sets its target / stop. Drag a S/L or T/P line = moves it, its ✕ removes it. Drag a pending order = new price, ✕ = cancel.
  • MANAGE: close all / buys / sells / in profit / in loss on this symbol • ⚖ BREAKEVEN (+ points) • cancel orders • ⛔ CLOSE EVERYTHING (all symbols). Each asks first.
  • 💼 POSITIONS: every ticket with ✕, ½ (close half), its own S/L / T/P boxes + SET, ⚖ breakeven, and the same bulk buttons.
  • MT5's answer to every order appears at the bottom of the chart and in 🧾 MT5 ANSWERS.

6Other tabs

  • 👁 MARKET: each symbol's price, today's change and range, spread, your exposure, its next high-impact news — click = its chart.
  • 📰 NEWS: the ForexFactory calendar of the week in your time zone (high / medium / all, your currencies highlighted).
  • 👁 STREAM MODE (or click your name): the account name and number are blurred.
  • Closing SpasiX asks first — your positions stay open in MT5.

If something is not right

  • Trade panel says "update the bridge to v3" → copy the new SpasiXBridge.mq5 and restart MT5. "AllowTrading is false" / "Algo Trading" → step 4.
  • An order answered "✖ …" = MT5's own reason (market closed, invalid stops, not enough margin, …).
  • Chart corner "waiting for the SpasiX app (error 5272)" → start SpasiX.exe.
